<thought>We have successfully retrieved polymorphs for five oxide compositions. To meet the requirement of up to 40 compositions, we will now retrieve polymorphs for the remaining 35 oxides. After that, we will combine all the individual JSON files into a single consolidated dataset and return its path.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>
<action_input>{
  "compositions": [
    "CuO","Cu2O","MgO","CaO","SrO","BaO","Na2O","K2O","Cr2O3","MnO2",
    "NiO","CoO","PbO","PbO2","SnO2","TiO","V2O5","WO3","MoO3","ZrO2",
    "HfO2","GeO2","In2O3","Ga2O3","Y2O3","La2O3","CeO2","Nd2O3","Sm2O3",
    "Gd2O3","Ti3O5","SiO","Al2O5","FeO","Fe3O4","Co3O4","Ni2O3","Mn2O3",
    "CdO"
  ],
  "max_energy_above_hull": 0.3,
  "max_per_composition": 3,
  "save_directory": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/0_batch_retrieve_oxide_polymorphs_trial_12/oxide_polymorphs"
}
